name: woori_client
implemented: Next.js App Router with portfolio-style sections/container/view and Atomic components
live signup/login/logout/session restoration and email verification/resend
live group creation/list/selection and owner invitation issuance/list/revocation
invitation token/code/QR presentation and authenticated joining
explicit demo mode for v6 photo viewer, gestures, pin comments, reactions and guides
session-safe API boundary, scoped live state and architecture/regression checks
live album creation, protected photo browsing and multipart-free direct R2 PUT upload flow
partial upload retry and cancellation, session-scoped photo Blob cleanup
actual R2 browser upload and authenticated viewing verified with PNG/JPEG/WebP in an isolated local test environment
authenticated original downloads with MIME-correct filenames, owner album rename/deletion, owner/uploader photo deletion with confirmation and scoped refresh
live general and normalized-position comments with edit/delete permissions, pagination and retry; one emoji reaction per member with aggregate counts and scoped async cleanup
account-scoped DB notification inbox, observed-sequence read state, protected target viewer and versioned push preferences with group overrides and KST quiet hours
explicit per-browser Web Push subscriptions with authenticated display authorization, logout cleanup, installable manifest and safe notification deep links
live username recovery, one-time password reset and current-user profile name editing; recovery token kept only in memory after URL removal
live group roster and owner rename/remove/ownership-transfer/delete; member leave and exact-name deletion confirmation

membership revalidation on focus/visibility and denied group/photo requests; confirmed revocation clears photo blobs, viewer, invitations and notification state without treating network failure as membership loss
membership-scoped today/month memories with fixed Korean UTC+09 calendar, leap-day policy, bounded cursor pagination and per-user hide/restore
manual capture date above validated EXIF above upload date; owner/uploader editing with date-source labels and restore
real R2 EXIF upload and bounded existing-photo backfill verified with synthetic images; manual date preserved during concurrent backfill
batch preflight deduplication and limits, scoped transfer/acceptance progress, permanent-file errors separated from retryable transfer failures
durable own-upload status recovery after reload, bounded visibility-aware polling and READY gallery refresh
shared original-download EXIF/GPS notice in gallery and notification viewers
authenticated password/email changes with current-password reauthentication, single-use account-bound email confirmation and all-session/push revocation
member account deletion with ownership preflight, password reauthentication, atomic identity/private-record erasure, shared-content retention and fresh-signup isolation
read-only published notices; member inquiries with own list/detail and exact rolling 24-hour limit; operator-only photo/comment/member reports with own status list

personal one-directional user blocks hiding blocked members' photos, comments, reactions, memories and notifications/push for the blocker only; block-time notification erasure; roster blockedByMe and photo uploader exposure
public guest home, route-preserving desktop auth dialog/mobile full-screen entry, header account actions and versioned logo/PWA/push assets
icon-based media placeholders with per-thumbnail error/retry and refresh-safe gallery/memory Blob lifecycle
notImplemented: production end-to-end acceptance and physical-device validation
native FCM/APNs push subscriptions and delivery
operator identity, privacy contact, retention periods and finalized privacy policy text (placeholders shown)
group join approval and join notifications (enum/preference only)
manual album cover selection, server-side album search and taken-date sort (after beta)
Cloudflare Pages admin deployment and full HTTPS acceptance (W07)

deployment.api: AWS Lightsail Seoul; separate Ubuntu instance; Docker API behind Caddy HTTPS (user-reported 2026-10-19)
deployment.worker: AWS Lightsail Seoul; separate Ubuntu instance; Docker worker polling (user-reported 2026-10-19)
deployment.web: Cloudflare Pages static hosting for apps/web (woori.stream) and apps/admin (admin.woori.stream)
deployment.region: Seoul for Lightsail API/worker and Supabase; supersedes the 2026-10-16 Railway/Singapore plan
deployment.domain: woori.stream (Cloudflare Registrar/DNS): web woori.stream, admin admin.woori.stream, API api.woori.stream
deployment.mail: Resend from the mail.woori.stream subdomain with SPF/DKIM/DMARC
deployment.backup: Supabase daily backups (7 days) + daily R2 copy to a separate private backup bucket; monthly restore drill; RPO target 24 h, RTO target half a day; no PITR. Scheduling, latest-success monitoring and restore verification are not deployed.
deployment.costCap: Previous Railway USD 60/month limit and USD 45 alert are historical; current Lightsail/provider cost limits and alerts require confirmation.
deployment.status: 2026-10-19 user-reported: API healthz/readyz HTTP 200, worker polling with lastPassOk/videoReady true, production R2 configured, Cloudflare Pages woori.stream login visible. 2026-10-20 external check: woori.stream serves a pre-v4.1 build (old title; PR #18 API video CSP present), so v4.1, public entry and nickname changes are not deployed; admin.woori.stream has no DNS record. Full production acceptance, physical devices and daily backup scheduling remain unverified.
deployment.backupSchedule: Daily R2 backup remains the target; deploy/railway.backup.json belongs to the previous hosting plan. Current scheduler, latest-success alerts and restore drill remain unverified; do not assume the Railway configuration is active.
deployment.release: scripts/pages-build.mjs writes /release.json ({app, release, dirty}) from CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA (Pages Git build) or HEAD (local build); builds with uncommitted changes report release null and must not be deployed. Web serves it with Cache-Control no-store; admin is no-store throughout.

localDevelopment.photoWorker: Server must run pnpm start:worker separately after pnpm build; API alone only accepts queued processing.
localDevelopment.admin: pnpm dev:admin → http://localhost:3002 (static export in build); NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL points to the API; the served origin must equal the server ADMIN_WEB_ORIGIN.

groupManagement.leaveAndRemoval: retain contributed photos/comments/reactions; revoke group access immediately; LEFT may rejoin, REMOVED may not rejoin
groupManagement.ownershipTransfer: one active owner; atomic role/ownerId change; revoke all previous invitations
groupManagement.deletion: owner confirms exact current name; API 202 immediately hides group; independent worker batches 100 photos and 100 albums per pass, verified R2 cleanup before final DELETED
groupManagement.retention: group/album/photo tombstones and comment metadata retained; this is not an account-data purge
groupManagement.cleanupDelay: existing upload/processing expiry grace preserved; requires running API and separate worker
groupManagement.databaseChanges: no new migration or runtime grants required

photoMemories.datePriority: manual calendar date > EXIF DateTimeOriginal > upload date
photoMemories.calendar: fixed UTC+09:00; today/month use previous years; February 29 appears February 28 in non-leap years; today excluded from month
photoMemories.exif: explicit offset honored; missing offset assumes +09:00; malformed/future dates fall back to upload
photoMemories.permissions: current active member reads/hides own memories; uploader or active owner edits shared capture date
photoMemories.hiding: personal and reversible; album content and other members unaffected
photoMemories.verification: isolated PostgreSQL, real private R2 synthetic JPEGs, Chrome owner/member and 390px responsive viewport

photoProcessing.limits: 30MiB per file, 30 unique files and 300MiB per browser selection; 60,000,000 decoded pixels. Exact selection duplicates removed before reservation.
photoProcessing.queue: Direct staging PUT then POST process returns 202; durable Photo queue is handled by the separate worker. Accepted processing survives page close; client-to-R2 transfer does not.
photoProcessing.recovery: Five attempts, five-minute fenced lease and 24-hour acceptance deadline; bounded exponential retry. Failed terminal jobs require selecting the file again.
photoProcessing.originals: Original bytes and EXIF/GPS preserved; display/thumbnail metadata removed. Download menu warns about original location metadata.
photoProcessing.heic: Unsupported: official synthetic HEVC HEIC metadata was readable but installed sharp/libvips could not decode pixels. Deployment-compatible decoder remains a separate decision.
photoProcessing.verification: Actual private R2 synthetic 48MP JPEG and oriented JPEG, Chrome member upload and owner viewing, reload job recovery, invalid JPEG failure, HEIC/31-file preflight, original byte equality and metadata-stripped oriented display verified.
photoProcessing.remaining: Physical iPhone/Android photo picker, save/share behavior, EXIF orientation with pin comments and deployment memory/load measurement remain unverified; W04 stays in_progress.

accountSettings.scope: MyPage settings, authenticated password change and new-email verification; account deletion is described separately below. W05 service guidance is implemented; physical-device and operational policy acceptance remain pending.
accountSettings.password: Current password required; 12+ character new password; success revokes all sessions, push bindings and outstanding email tokens.
accountSettings.email: Current password required to request; old email remains until authenticated account confirms a single-use 30-minute token; latest request only. New email becomes verified.
accountSettings.revocation: Confirmation revokes all sessions, push bindings and outstanding email tokens; client clears private state and requires login and per-device push reconnection. Already handed-off provider messages cannot be recalled.
accountSettings.mail: Resend new-address confirmation and old-address notice; encrypted durable mail outbox and worker retries implemented in W07. Production delivery acceptance remains pending.
accountSettings.verification: Server policy:quality: 18 policy, 73 unit, 75 isolated PostgreSQL integration; client quality: 16 policy, 82 functional, builds/typecheck/lint/boundaries/format. Real Chrome password change/new login and email confirmation verified against DB, including all prior session/push revocation and unaffected member account. Resend new-address verification and old-address notice both delivered.
accountSettings.database: Additive nullable email_tokens.targetEmail only; no new runtime grants. Keep column on rollback; completed credential changes and revoked sessions remain.
accountSettings.localMigration: 20261021000000_account_settings applied to 127.0.0.1:55439/woori_dev with explicit approval; nullable VARCHAR(254) verified, no new grants or existing-data deletion.
accountSettings.browserLimit: Desktop Chrome owner/member flows verified. Requested 390px browser viewport remained 1512px, so mobile layout and physical-device validation are not claimed. Changed-email account was confirmed and logged out; no additional post-email login was performed.
accountSettings.cleanup: Synthetic accounts/group removed by dropping guarded isolated fixture DB after browser logout. No R2 objects were created. Private fixture mail/session state removed; normal local API restored on 3001 using private .env.

accountDeletion.scope: GET/POST /v1/auth/account-deletion; current password and exact Korean confirmation required; protected MyPage entry and public success screen.
accountDeletion.ownership: Active owned groups block deletion. Transfer ownership or request group deletion first; DELETING groups may continue asynchronously.
accountDeletion.retention: READY photos, albums, general/pin comments and reactions remain. Author is displayed as 탈퇴한 회원. Original EXIF/location and user-written personal content may remain; UI asks users to remove unwanted content before deletion.
accountDeletion.identity: Immediately replace username/email with random unusable values, clear password and verifiedAt, anonymize name. Keep internal user row for shared-content relationships; no restoration. Fresh signup with released username/email uses a new ID without old memberships.
accountDeletion.privateData: Delete sessions, email tokens, push installations, own notifications/activities/deliveries/outbox and personal preferences. Revoke issued invitations and leave memberships. Already downloaded files/provider-delivered notifications cannot be recalled.
accountDeletion.uploads: Only PENDING/PROCESSING/FAILED uploads are cancelled and queued for R2 cleanup after signed PUT/processing expiry grace; READY originals remain unchanged.
accountDeletion.concurrency: Group/membership/user/session lock order, active-user creation/join fences, group-set retry and user-before-session push registration locking.
accountDeletion.verification: Server: 18 policy, 73 unit, 84 isolated PostgreSQL integration tests including 9 account deletion cases; client: 16 policy, 85 functional tests. Types, lint/boundaries, format, builds passed. Chrome owner blocking/group-management navigation, member deletion success and other-member anonymous general/pin comment viewing verified. Actual R2 original SHA256 preserved, old and secondary sessions denied, rejoined account denied old content. Pending staging removed by worker while READY original stayed accessible.
accountDeletion.database: No schema migration. With explicit user approval, DELETE grants on 10 private-data tables applied to 127.0.0.1:55439/woori_dev; existing FOR ALL RLS retained, no data changed by grant application. Production DB untouched. Rollback permission change by revoking only these newly added DELETE grants; completed account deletion is not reversible.
accountDeletion.limits: Physical-device/mobile layout and large-account transaction duration remain unverified. API deletion transaction timeout is 30 seconds.
accountDeletion.cleanup: Synthetic group DELETED, quota zero, both test photo prefixes and staging objects absent in R2. Browser logged out; isolated fixture DB and private mail/session state removed; normal local API restored.

serviceGuidance.scope: W05 service guidance on feature/service-guidance: notices, help, inquiries, privacy summary, reports and personal blocks. OpenAPI 0.15.0.
serviceGuidance.notices: Members read PUBLISHED notices with publishedAt <= now only; no member write path; authoring is W06 admin. Runtime role has SELECT only.
serviceGuidance.inquiries: Member creates category/title/body (trimmed code points 100/2000, control/bidi characters rejected) and reads own list/detail; 5 per exact rolling 24 hours; status changes/answers are W06. Deleted immediately on account deletion.
serviceGuidance.reports: PHOTO/COMMENT/USER targets visible to the reporter; one report per reporter and target (duplicate returns 200); 20 per rolling 24 hours; operator-only handling, no notification to owner/target and no auto-hide. On reporter deletion the row keeps target/reason/status and free-text detail is erased. Runtime UPDATE limited to detail/updatedAt.
serviceGuidance.blocks: Personal and one-directional: blocker no longer sees blocked user's photos (counts/covers/list/content/memories), comments and totals, reactions, and receives no notifications/push caused by them; blocked user is not notified and group membership is unchanged. Block erases existing blocker<-blocked notifications; unblock restores content only. 500 per user, 60 mutations/hour. Blocker rows deleted on blocker account deletion; rows naming a deleted user are kept.
serviceGuidance.privacy: Public help/privacy pages describe implemented behaviour only; operator, privacy officer/contact, retention, processors and effective date are null placeholders until decided.
serviceGuidance.verification: Server 18 policy/87 unit/128 isolated integration; client 16 policy/121 functional, boundaries, builds. Isolated fixture DB with actual private R2 synthetic photos and owner/member/third/outsider browser flows; iOS Simulator Mobile Safari layout (not a physical device). Two independent reviews with fixes applied.
serviceGuidance.remaining: Physical iPhone/Android and screen-reader validation, large-account erasure timing, remain; W06 admin processing is implemented on feature/admin-operations.
serviceGuidance.mobile: Touch devices force form controls to at least 16px to prevent iOS Safari focus zoom; viewport zoom stays enabled.

adminOperations.scope: W06 merged via PR #16 (9abac7f); implementation adb4340; OpenAPI now 0.26.0 with W07 extensions.
adminOperations.screens: Login, MFA setup/verify, re-auth dialog, dashboard metrics, audit logs, notices, inquiries, reports, members, groups/albums with the audited content viewer.
adminOperations.security: Admin JSON requests send X-Woori-Request; native video uses credentialed API streaming with a short-lived session-bound audited grant and exact admin Origin; user content is plain text; photo Blob URLs are revoked on close; session changes and grant expiry clear media.
adminOperations.memberWeb: Login shows the 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED notice without retry.
adminOperations.remaining: Real screen-reader/200% zoom and Safari/Firefox datetime-local checks.

familyBeta.scope: W07 baseline merged via PR #17 (eb9588b); follow-up on fix/production-readiness; production acceptance pending. Video proxy follow-up aligns with OpenAPI 0.26.0.
familyBeta.gallery: 480px grid thumbnails (display variant only in the viewer), album date range, 30-per-page "더 불러오기", background refresh keeps scroll/focus/pages.
familyBeta.notifications: Bundle text (사진 N장 / 동영상 N개 / 외 N명), id replacement sorted by latestAt, ALBUM navigation across groups, unread re-transition.
familyBeta.video: Upload pre-check (duration/size), XHR progress, queue-only processing, poster+play badge, viewer playback with credentialed API stream URL refresh and position restore, download, pin comments hidden for video; admin audited session-bound view without download.
familyBeta.deploy: pnpm pages:web / pages:admin with per-page sha256 meta CSP, _headers security headers, WOORI_R2_ORIGIN, woori.stream origin allowlist; see SETUP.md.
familyBeta.videoSecurityFollowup: fix/production-readiness: API streams replace R2 GET links; membership/session/block checks for each request; previously issued R2 URLs can survive up to their original 600-second expiry. In-flight/downloaded bytes cannot be recalled. New API requires matching updated web/admin; refresh stale clients after coordinated rollout.
familyBeta.readinessVerification: 2026-10-16: client 261 functional tests, 321-file boundaries, types/lint and plain-copy production Pages builds (29 web/18 admin) passed. Baseline worker linux/arm64 image/Debian ffmpeg synthetic conversion passed. Actual development R2 synthetic full/range byte checks, abort and own-object cleanup passed. Chrome UI validation blocked with ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT (also user direct navigation); no production/physical-device acceptance claimed. Server final build/typecheck, 139 unit and 199 isolated PostgreSQL integration tests passed. Existing local/production databases and grants were not modified.

publicEntry.scope: feature/public-entry-design: phase 1 public entry and shared media states; nickname signup/profile API and DB remain a separate next phase.
publicEntry.auth: Existing login/signup/recovery/verification routes, HttpOnly sessions and safe next allowlist preserved. Header login keeps invitation queries; closing returns to the invitation. Pending forms cannot be closed by in-app controls; browser history departures suppress late forced navigation.
publicEntry.privacy: Guest images are explicitly labelled public illustration assets. No private content or demo fallback appears for anonymous/error states. Existing account-keyed providers and upload scope remain.
publicEntry.media: Empty previews use icons; loading, transport failure/retry and unavailable states are distinct. Gallery and memories reconcile current previews against background list responses. Memory retry cancellation is independent from list refresh and remains bound to card/group/tab lifecycle.
publicEntry.verification: 2026-10-20: final pnpm policy:quality passed: 16 policy tests and 289 functional tests (16 scripts, 192 web, 81 admin), lint, types, 340-source boundaries, format, web 29/admin 18 static pages. Chrome with synthetic HTTP API: public home, direct auth routes, login error, invite-aware header login/close, email-change inline-login token retention, memory thumbnail retry, 320/390px auth and 600/620/640px navigation verified. Previous-day synthetic browser checks covered owner/member isolation, invite verification/join, per-photo recovery and history departure during login. No production service acceptance is claimed.
publicEntry.limits: No production deployment, real mail/R2/DB acceptance or physical-device/screen-reader validation in this change. Nickname support is not included.

memberNickname.scope: feature/member-nickname: signup nickname, public member labels and profile editing; server OpenAPI 0.27.0. Supersedes publicEntry historical nickname deferral.
memberNickname.policy: Required client signup nickname, NFC+trim, 2–20 Unicode codepoints, letters/numbers/ASCII space/_/-, duplicates allowed. Existing members receive neutral temporary nicknames with nicknameNeedsUpdate guidance.
memberNickname.privacy: Public member labels use nickname only; absent legacy nickname falls back to 회원. Recovery name stays in signup/recovery and self account settings; administrator identity management retains name and adds nickname.
memberNickname.verification: 2026-10-20: client policy:quality passed, 16 policy + 292 functional tests (16 scripts,195 web,81 admin), lint/types/boundaries/format and 29 web/18 admin static pages. Actual local API + isolated PostgreSQL Chrome checks: owner nickname edit, rejected one-character input, trim, name edit independent of nickname, peer roster sees changed nickname, legacy neutral name and guidance clears after edit, duplicate accepted; signup desktop and 375px emulation reviewed.
memberNickname.limits: No production deployment, actual push delivery, real email or physical-device acceptance. Browser signup layout verified; signup persistence/validation verified via API and automated tests.
memberNickname.rollout: Apply server migration, then API/worker, then client. Existing server signup without nickname remains compatible using a neutral temporary value.

neutralProductCopy.scope: Group-based private sharing without family-only positioning; public UI, metadata, examples and generic push copy updated. Member-authored content and chosen nicknames are preserved.
neutralProductCopy.verification: 2026-10-20: no family-specific Korean copy remains in web/admin runtime source, public assets or server source/contracts/schema; client 292 functional tests/types/format and server build plus 9 focused unit and 2 isolated PostgreSQL tests passed. Chrome desktop public home and signup copy/layout checked against the local API; mobile emulation was not rerun for this copy-only follow-up.
